title: Israel's Shepherd, Guide Us, Feed Us
description: Israel's Shepherd, Guide Us, Feed Us in Tonic Solfa to ALL FOR JESUS, doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 2 verses and a piano.
about: Edward Bickersteth wrote these words. They were printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1848), as hymn 58, “Closing Hymn”.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Eights and Sevens (8.7.8.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ALL FOR JESUS; any other Eights and Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Is-rael's Shep-herd, guide us, feed us, Through our pil-grim-age be-low, And be-side the wa-ters lead us, Where Thy flock re-joic-ing go.

lines: Israel's Shepherd, guide us, feed us,
And beside the waters lead us,
We have found Thee, and would never,

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: Edward Bickersteth died in 1850.
credits: Words by Edward Bickersteth (1786–1850), public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848); set to ALL FOR JESUS by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
